notes: Scientific-result scoring only. Ordinary limitations/uncertainty prose is optional and unscored. Preserve all required identity, state, convergence, frequency/path, energy-definition and evidence checks. Score actual supported components; honest partial/failed submissions are valid but earn no unavailable result credit. Failed optional attempts do not invalidate completed primary work.
